title: Australia Lost a War… Against Birds 🐦 #shorts
description:
In 1932 Australia sent soldiers with machine guns to fight 20,000 emus – and lost. The true story of the Great Emu War.

#shorts #facts #crazyfacts #history #didyouknow

scenes.text: Australia once lost a war. Against birds.
In 1932, about twenty thousand emus invaded the wheat farms of Western Australia.
scenes.label: EMUS

scenes.text: So the government sent in soldiers. With machine guns.
But emus can sprint up to fifty kilometers per hour, and they scattered in every direction.
After weeks of fighting and thousands of bullets, the soldiers simply gave up.
The emus won. To this day, it's called the Great Emu War.
